auditName: Grok Power Tools full system reliability and functionality audit

repo.gitStatusShort: Detached HEAD at 735ccf7 when Task 9 download/reconciliation evidence was generated; pre-existing untracked .superpowers/ left untouched.

canaries.prompt: AUDIT CANARY 2026-05-20 image: a clean product-style tabletop photo of a small chrome compass on a white desk, no text, square composition, neutral lighting.
AUDIT CANARY 2026-05-20 video: a five-second gentle camera push toward the small chrome compass on a white desk, no text, minimal motion, neutral lighting.

blockers.details: Chrome automation blocked navigation to the live chrome-extension:// popup page by URL policy. Task 5 used source UI preview only and did not inspect live popup storage values.

Wrangler R2 listing is blocked by current Cloudflare OAuth/account state: account e8d3925cac56cc5a4927c16024531994 reports R2 disabled with code 10042; accounts ae55f67eccbee0bca65247faea6d5024 and ba5339fd86e87c226bdc306347636042 report authentication error code 10000.
Canary R2 sync was not run because live extension popup config access is still policy-blocked, so Worker URL/API key presence could not be verified without bypassing the browser policy.
